# turbo

> The Energy fleet's **backend / runtime** domain-expert employee — a senior backend engineer that scaffolds
> and audits TS-strict Hono services, reads the asterisk on every "this is solved now" claim, and designs the
> racy-state class of bug out by construction. A tool-employee operated by coding agents (CLI + MCP) and
> watched by the chairman (the local cockpit). Powered by Energy.

This is the agent-readable map of turbo's docs and surfaces. **Read `AGENTS.md` first** for how to invoke
every tool, the hard boundary, and the NOT-list. Paths are repo-relative to `~/turbo`.

**One-line default stack:** Hono ≥4.12.25 · Node 24 LTS (floor 22) · Zod 4.4 · `@hono/zod-openapi` 1.x ·
Result<T,E> · SSE · Bun for CLIs/tests · ship Vercel-Node, promote latency-critical to Cloudflare Workers.

## Tools — the `turbo` CLI (Bash-invokable, `--json` on data commands)
- `turbo api --spec <openapi> [--out <dir>] [--runtime node|workers] [--json]` — **THE acceptance test:** OpenAPI → typed Hono service, contract tests green.
- `turbo scaffold [--name <n>] [--out <dir>]` — blank law-compliant Hono service (w3cj baseline, deps bumped).
- `turbo audit <dir> [--json]` — the 16-pitfall audit over a service (findings keyed by P-ID).
- `turbo check [--json]` — version-drift oracle (stale pins, the Hono security floor, EOL runtimes). Offline-safe.
- `turbo contract <dir> [--diff <old-spec>]` — contract-test vs `/openapi.json` + RPC `typeof app` + a spec diff-gate.
- `turbo stream-doctor <file>` — audit a streaming route for the SSE traps.
- `turbo migrate-plan <dir> --to <fastify|hono>` — a Strangler-Fig migration plan (never big-bang).
- `turbo brain <query>` — BM25 ranked search over `brain/` (the Memory layer).
- `turbo explain <P-id|S-id|O-id>` — print a pitfall/scenario/opinion by ID with detection + fix.
- `turbo eval [--level 1|2|3]` — run the eval pyramid (G1–G13).

## MCP server (turbo's OWN — 8 tools)
- [.mcp.json](./.mcp.json): the `turbo` server entry (env-ref keys only — no literal secrets).
- **Endpoint / transport:** default **stdio** — `node dist/mcp/server.js` (or the `turbo-mcp` bin). Each tool
  shells out to the `turbo` CLI with `--json`. A hosted **`@hono/mcp` Streamable-HTTP** variant is the
  documented dual-mode (same tool list over HTTP).
- **`tools/list`** returns: `scaffold_service` (→`turbo scaffold`), `gen_from_openapi` (→`turbo api`),
  `audit_service` (→`turbo audit`), `check_versions` (→`turbo check`), `contract_test` (→`turbo contract`),
  `stream_doctor` (→`turbo stream-doctor`), `explain_pitfall` (→`turbo explain`), `search_brain` (→`turbo brain`).

## Skills (`skills/*/SKILL.md` — each calls a real `turbo` verb)
- [scaffold-hono-service](./skills/scaffold-hono-service/SKILL.md): S-10 + O-02/O-08/O-09 — reference baseline, bump pins, the file layout, the law checklist. → `turbo scaffold` / `api` / `audit`.
- [audit-serverless-state](./skills/audit-serverless-state/SKILL.md): S-01 + O-01 + P-02 — the `new Map()`/Fluid data-bleed grep, externalize-or-pass-ID. → `turbo audit`.
- [zod-boundary-and-patch](./skills/zod-boundary-and-patch/SKILL.md): S-02 + O-04 + P-04/P-05 — parse-don't-validate, the dedicated no-default PATCH schema, the v3→v4 breaks. → `turbo audit` / `explain P-04`.
- [sse-streaming-safely](./skills/sse-streaming-safely/SKILL.md): S-08 + O-12 + P-10/P-11/P-12 — the 3rd-arg handler, `X-Accel-Buffering:no`, `while(!aborted)`. → `turbo stream-doctor`.
- [design-api-contract](./skills/design-api-contract/SKILL.md): O-07/O-08/O-10/O-11 — route by consumer, OpenAPI-from-Zod, URL-`/v1` additive-only, be-the-17% contract tests. → `turbo api` / `contract` / `brain`.

## The brain (Memory — the six expertise artifacts)
- [brain/MOC - turbo.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20turbo.md): the master hub for the brain.
- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the map of mastery, by job-to-be-done (start here).
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the anti-slop taste layer (O-01…O-16; the "single taste").
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): version-specific gotchas with detection + fix (P-01…P-16).
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): the golden eval tasks (S-01…S-13).
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): canonical tools, defaults vs alts, agent-access, required secrets.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where sources disagree + what turbo settles by experiment.
- Query it: `turbo brain "<query>"` (BM25 ranked) or `turbo explain <id>`.

## Sub-agents (`.claude/agents/` — flat, two distinct scopes; both `model: opus`)
- [runtime-safety-auditor](./.claude/agents/runtime-safety-auditor.md): the 🔴 data-bleed/crash class — S-01/P-02, S-08/P-10-12, S-02/P-04, S-11. **Packaged as a reusable cross-harness sub-agent.**
- [contract-reviewer](./.claude/agents/contract-reviewer.md): the contract-drift class — S-06, S-09, S-12.

## Plugin / hooks / RSI
- [.claude-plugin/manifest.json](./.claude-plugin/manifest.json): the Claude Code plugin bundle (CLI + MCP + 5 skills + hooks + 2 agents).
- [.claude/settings.json](./.claude/settings.json): hook wiring — a `tsc --noEmit` commit-gate + a `new Map()`/PATCH grep-gate (the dogfood: turbo's harness obeys turbo's law). Blocks logged to `.claude/hooks/gate.log`.
- [workflows/rsi.workflow.js](./workflows/rsi.workflow.js): the deterministic $0 RSI loop (the 6 dsip steps). `node workflows/rsi.workflow.js --deterministic`.

## The hard boundary (do NOT cross)
**turbo owns API/runtime ONLY.** Rate-limit / cache / KV / edge-store creds = **echo's** seam (Wave 2). turbo
emits `cache-control`/`ETag`/`Vary` *header semantics* and stops — **echo** holds the store. `rhinobase/hono-rate-limiter`
is flagged do-NOT-wire. turbo never holds cross-request state in process (the law). Other verticals: frontend
→ pixel · mobile → pebble · DB → acorn · auth → badge · billing → penny · deploy/CI → rocket.

## ID index (the queryable vocabulary)
- **P-** = pitfalls (`brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md`, P-01…P-16) — symptom → version/condition → detection → fix. e.g. **P-02** `new Map()`/Fluid race · **P-04** Zod `.default()` PATCH data loss · **P-09** strip-types ≠ type-check.
- **S-** = battle-tested scenarios (`brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md`, S-01…S-13) — golden eval tasks, each with a binary VERIFY. e.g. **S-01** cross-user data bleed · **S-08** SSE traps · **S-10** scaffold-from-reference.
- **O-** = opinions (`brain/OPINIONS.md`, O-01…O-16) — ALWAYS X / NEVER Y / because Z + escape hatch. e.g. **O-01** externalize state · **O-04** no-default PATCH schema · **O-12** SSE default + 3rd-arg handler.
- **G-** = golden tasks (`PLAN.md` §6 / `eval/`, G1–G13) — the eval pyramid, mapped to S-IDs.
